en: 1 Kings 6

p.src: 1  In the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month Ziv, which is the second month, he began to build the LORD’s house.

ja: 、ソロモンがイスラエルを治めて
目のジブの月、すなわち
en: In the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month Ziv, which is the second month, he began to build the LORD’s house.
u.src: 1  In the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month Ziv, which is the second month, he began to build the LORD’s house.

p.src: 2  The house which King Solomon built for the LORD had a length of sixty cubits, and its width twenty, and its height thirty cubits.

en: The house which King Solomon built for the LORD had a length of sixty cubits, and its width twenty, and its height thirty cubits.
u.src: 2  The house which King Solomon built for the LORD had a length of sixty cubits, and its width twenty, and its height thirty cubits.

ja: 6:2 一キュビトは肘から中指の先までの長さで、約46センチメートル、または18インチである。
en: 6:2 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters.

p.src: 3  The porch in front of the temple of the house had a length of twenty cubits, which was along the width of the house. Ten cubits was its width in front of the house.

ja: キュビト、神殿の正面から張り出す
en: The porch in front of the temple of the house had a length of twenty cubits, which was along the width of the house. Ten cubits was its width in front of the house.
u.src: 3  The porch in front of the temple of the house had a length of twenty cubits, which was along the width of the house. Ten cubits was its width in front of the house.

p.src: 4  He made windows of fixed lattice work for the house.

en: He made windows of fixed lattice work for the house.
u.src: 4  He made windows of fixed lattice work for the house.

p.src: 5  Against the wall of the house, he built floors all around, against the walls of the house all around, both of the temple and of the inner sanctuary; and he made side rooms all around.

ja: って、その周囲に脇屋を建てた。それは神
en: Against the wall of the house, he built floors all around, against the walls of the house all around, both of the temple and of the inner sanctuary; and he made side rooms all around.
u.src: 5  Against the wall of the house, he built floors all around, against the walls of the house all around, both of the temple and of the inner sanctuary; and he made side rooms all around.

p.src: 6  The lowest floor was five cubits wide, and the middle was six cubits wide, and the third was seven cubits wide; for on the outside he made offsets in the wall of the house all around, that the beams should not be inserted into the walls of the house.

ja: キュビトであった。梁を神殿の
に差し込まずにすむよう、外壁の
en: The lowest floor was five cubits wide, and the middle was six cubits wide, and the third was seven cubits wide; for on the outside he made offsets in the wall of the house all around, that the beams should not be inserted into the walls of the house.
u.src: 6  The lowest floor was five cubits wide, and the middle was six cubits wide, and the third was seven cubits wide; for on the outside he made offsets in the wall of the house all around, that the beams should not be inserted into the walls of the house.

p.src: 7  The house, when it was under construction, was built of stone prepared at the quarry; and no hammer or ax or any tool of iron was heard in the house while it was under construction.

en: The house, when it was under construction, was built of stone prepared at the quarry; and no hammer or ax or any tool of iron was heard in the house while it was under construction.
u.src: 7  The house, when it was under construction, was built of stone prepared at the quarry; and no hammer or ax or any tool of iron was heard in the house while it was under construction.

p.src: 8  The door for the middle side rooms was in the right side of the house. They went up by winding stairs into the middle floor, and out of the middle into the third.

en: The door for the middle side rooms was in the right side of the house. They went up by winding stairs into the middle floor, and out of the middle into the third.
u.src: 8  The door for the middle side rooms was in the right side of the house. They went up by winding stairs into the middle floor, and out of the middle into the third.

p.src: 9  So he built the house and finished it; and he covered the house with beams and planks of cedar.

en: So he built the house and finished it; and he covered the house with beams and planks of cedar.
u.src: 9  So he built the house and finished it; and he covered the house with beams and planks of cedar.

p.src: 10  He built the floors all along the house, each five cubits high; and they rested on the house with timbers of cedar.

ja: キュビトの脇屋を建て、
en: He built the floors all along the house, each five cubits high; and they rested on the house with timbers of cedar.
u.src: 10  He built the floors all along the house, each five cubits high; and they rested on the house with timbers of cedar.

p.src: 11  The LORD’s word came to Solomon, saying,

ja: のことばがソロモンに
en: The LORD’s word came to Solomon, saying,
u.src: 11  The LORD’s word came to Solomon, saying,

p.src: 12  “Concerning this house which you are building, if you will walk in my statutes, and execute my ordinances, and keep all my commandments to walk in them, then I will establish my word with you, which I spoke to David your father.

ja: てているこの家について
う。もしあなたがわたしの
むなら、わたしはあなたの
en: “Concerning this house which you are building, if you will walk in my statutes, and execute my ordinances, and keep all my commandments to walk in them, then I will establish my word with you, which I spoke to David your father.
u.src: 12  “Concerning this house which you are building, if you will walk in my statutes, and execute my ordinances, and keep all my commandments to walk in them, then I will establish my word with you, which I spoke to David your father.

p.src: 13  I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.”

ja: わたしはイスラエルの
en: I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.”
u.src: 13  I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.”

p.src: 14  So Solomon built the house and finished it.

ja: こうしてソロモンは家を
en: So Solomon built the house and finished it.
u.src: 14  So Solomon built the house and finished it.

p.src: 15  He built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar; from the floor of the house to the walls of the ceiling, he covered them on the inside with wood. He covered the floor of the house with cypress boards.

en: He built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar; from the floor of the house to the walls of the ceiling, he covered them on the inside with wood. He covered the floor of the house with cypress boards.
u.src: 15  He built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar; from the floor of the house to the walls of the ceiling, he covered them on the inside with wood. He covered the floor of the house with cypress boards.

p.src: 16  He built twenty cubits of the back part of the house with boards of cedar from the floor to the ceiling. He built this within, for an inner sanctuary, even for the most holy place.

en: He built twenty cubits of the back part of the house with boards of cedar from the floor to the ceiling. He built this within, for an inner sanctuary, even for the most holy place.
u.src: 16  He built twenty cubits of the back part of the house with boards of cedar from the floor to the ceiling. He built this within, for an inner sanctuary, even for the most holy place.

p.src: 17  In front of the temple sanctuary was forty cubits long.

en: In front of the temple sanctuary was forty cubits long.
u.src: 17  In front of the temple sanctuary was forty cubits long.

p.src: 18  There was cedar on the house within, carved with buds and open flowers. All was cedar. No stone was visible.

ja: の彫刻が施されていた。すべてが
en: There was cedar on the house within, carved with buds and open flowers. All was cedar. No stone was visible.
u.src: 18  There was cedar on the house within, carved with buds and open flowers. All was cedar. No stone was visible.

p.src: 19  He prepared an inner sanctuary in the middle of the house within, to set the ark of the LORD’s covenant there.

ja: くために、家の内側の奥に内側の聖所を準備した。
en: He prepared an inner sanctuary in the middle of the house within, to set the ark of the LORD’s covenant there.
u.src: 19  He prepared an inner sanctuary in the middle of the house within, to set the ark of the LORD’s covenant there.

p.src: 20  Within the inner sanctuary was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in width, and twenty cubits in its height. He overlaid it with pure gold. He covered the altar with cedar.

en: Within the inner sanctuary was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in width, and twenty cubits in its height. He overlaid it with pure gold. He covered the altar with cedar.
u.src: 20  Within the inner sanctuary was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in width, and twenty cubits in its height. He overlaid it with pure gold. He covered the altar with cedar.

p.src: 21  So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold. He drew chains of gold across before the inner sanctuary, and he overlaid it with gold.

ja: こうしてソロモンは家の
った。彼は内側の聖所の前に金の鎖を渡し、それを金で覆った。
en: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold. He drew chains of gold across before the inner sanctuary, and he overlaid it with gold.
u.src: 21  So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold. He drew chains of gold across before the inner sanctuary, and he overlaid it with gold.

p.src: 22  He overlaid the whole house with gold, until all the house was finished. He also overlaid the whole altar that belonged to the inner sanctuary with gold.

en: He overlaid the whole house with gold, until all the house was finished. He also overlaid the whole altar that belonged to the inner sanctuary with gold.
u.src: 22  He overlaid the whole house with gold, until all the house was finished. He also overlaid the whole altar that belonged to the inner sanctuary with gold.

p.src: 23  In the inner sanctuary he made two cherubim of olive wood, each ten cubits high.

ja: に、高さ十キュビトのオリーブの
つのケルビム を造った。
en: In the inner sanctuary he made two cherubim of olive wood, each ten cubits high.
u.src: 23  In the inner sanctuary he made two cherubim of olive wood, each ten cubits high.

ja: 6:23 「ケルビム」は「ケルブ」の複数形で、御使いのような存在である。
en: 6:23 “Cherubim” is plural of “cherub”, an angelic being.

p.src: 24  Five cubits was the length of one wing of the cherub, and five cubits was the length of the other wing of the cherub. From the tip of one wing to the tip of the other was ten cubits.

ja: キュビト、ケルブのもう一つの
en: Five cubits was the length of one wing of the cherub, and five cubits was the length of the other wing of the cherub. From the tip of one wing to the tip of the other was ten cubits.
u.src: 24  Five cubits was the length of one wing of the cherub, and five cubits was the length of the other wing of the cherub. From the tip of one wing to the tip of the other was ten cubits.

p.src: 25  The other cherub was ten cubits. Both the cherubim were of one measure and one form.

ja: キュビトであった。両方のケルビムは
en: The other cherub was ten cubits. Both the cherubim were of one measure and one form.
u.src: 25  The other cherub was ten cubits. Both the cherubim were of one measure and one form.

p.src: 26  One cherub was ten cubits high, and so was the other cherub.

en: One cherub was ten cubits high, and so was the other cherub.
u.src: 26  One cherub was ten cubits high, and so was the other cherub.

p.src: 27  He set the cherubim within the inner house. The wings of the cherubim were stretched out, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the middle of the house.

ja: いた。ケルビムは翼を広げ、一方のケルブの
en: He set the cherubim within the inner house. The wings of the cherubim were stretched out, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the middle of the house.
u.src: 27  He set the cherubim within the inner house. The wings of the cherubim were stretched out, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the middle of the house.

p.src: 28  He overlaid the cherubim with gold.

en: He overlaid the cherubim with gold.
u.src: 28  He overlaid the cherubim with gold.

ja: は家の周囲のすべての
も、ケルビム、なつめやしの
en: He carved all the walls of the house around with carved figures of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, inside and outside.
u.src: 29  He carved all the walls of the house around with carved figures of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, inside and outside.

p.src: 30  He overlaid the floor of the house with gold, inside and outside.

en: He overlaid the floor of the house with gold, inside and outside.
u.src: 30  He overlaid the floor of the house with gold, inside and outside.

p.src: 31  For the entrance of the inner sanctuary, he made doors of olive wood. The lintel and door posts were a fifth part of the wall.

en: For the entrance of the inner sanctuary, he made doors of olive wood. The lintel and door posts were a fifth part of the wall.

った。彼はケルビムとなつめやしの

en: He also made the entrance of the temple door posts of olive wood, out of a fourth part of the wall,

p.src: 34  and two doors of cypress wood. The two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.

en: and two doors of cypress wood. The two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.
